switchReferenceAnalysis.scope: Only the shadcn light unchecked finding; no assertion of overall WCAG failure or complete dark reference equivalence.

reference.retrieval: Pinned official raw GitHub read; no main-branch substitution.
observedRules: Unchecked track uses input color with a transparent border; the thumb uses the background color.
Pinned light globals define input oklch(0.922 0 0), background oklch(1 0 0).
Pinned dark uses a translucent input role; exact dark pixel equivalence was not claimed.

semanticFacts: light surface.highest references neutral.200; control.toggleThumb references white.
light border.default references neutral.200; border.strong references neutral.500.
currentMapping.themeBoundary: components/rc-theme/src/theme.ts binds those L2 values; selection-theme.ts leaves the shadcn thumb without a shadow.
l3Facts: Unchecked track uses color.surface.highest; thumb uses color.control.toggle-thumb.
Default track border uses color.border.default, which is the same light neutral tone as the track.

switchReferenceAnalysis.assessment: The observed light low-contrast mode is present in the locked reference. No light color-mapping inversion or missing source role was found. The screenshot finding remains a project desktop-usability concern, not a claim that the reference or product is globally noncompliant.
